1→# Unified Task Creation System
     2→
     3→## Purpose
     4→
     5→Single `create-task` edge function replaces per-tool edge functions. Parameter processing happens client-side; the edge function only authenticates and inserts into `tasks`.
     6→
     7→## Source of Truth
     8→
     9→| What | Where |
    10→|------|-------|
    11→| Shared utilities (`createTask`, `generateTaskId`, etc.) | `src/shared/lib/taskCreation.ts` |
    12→| Task-specific helpers | `src/shared/lib/tasks/*.ts` |
    13→| Edge function | `supabase/functions/create-task/` |
    14→| Task type routing | `task_types` table (DB) |
    15→
    16→## Architecture
    17→
    18→```
    19→UI Component
    20→  → Task Helper (src/shared/lib/tasks/*.ts) — validates, builds payload
    21→    → createTask() (src/shared/lib/taskCreation.ts)
    22→      → create-task Edge Function — authenticates, inserts row
    23→        → DB Trigger: on_task_created — looks up task_types, sets run_type
    24→          → Worker picks up task (see task_worker_lifecycle.md)
    25→```
    26→
    27→## Authentication Flow
    28→
    29→The `create-task` edge function supports three auth methods, checked in order:
    30→
    31→| Method | When Used | How It Works |
    32→|--------|-----------|--------------|
    33→| Service Role | Internal/server calls | Token matches `SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` |
    34→| JWT | Frontend (Supabase auth) | Decodes JWT, extracts `payload.sub` as user ID |
    35→| PAT | External API integrations | Looks up token in `user_api_tokens` table |
    36→
    37→## The `task_type` to `task_types` Contract
    38→
    39→When `createTask({ task_type: 'travel_orchestrator', ... })` is called:
    40→
    41→1. `task_type` string is stored in `tasks.task_type` column
    42→2. DB trigger `on_task_created` looks up this string in `task_types.name`
    43→3. The matching row's `run_type` (`'gpu'` or `'api'`) determines which worker pool claims it
    44→4. **If no matching `task_types` row exists, defaults to `run_type='gpu'`**
    45→
    46→The `task_types` table also carries `category`, `base_cost_per_second`, and `cost_factors` for billing. See the table definition in migrations.
    47→
    48→## Full Task Lifecycle
    49→
    50→```
    51→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    52→│                   TASK CREATION (this doc)                        │
    53→├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    54→│  UI → Task Helper → createTask() → create-task EF               │
    55→│       │  Validates params, builds payload    │  Auth + INSERT    │
    56→│       │                                      ▼                   │
    57→│       │                          tasks row (status='Queued')    │
    58→│       │                                      │                   │
    59→│       ▼                                      ▼                   │
    60→│                      DB Trigger: on_task_created                 │
    61→│                      Looks up task_types → sets run_type         │
    62→└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    63→                                │
    64→                                ▼
    65→┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    66→│              TASK EXECUTION (task_worker_lifecycle.md)            │
    67→├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    68→│  Worker polls for tasks matching its run_type                    │
    69→│       → Claims task (status → 'In Progress')                      │
    70→│       → Executes (GPU inference / API call)                      │
    71→│       → Calls complete-task EF                                   │
    72→│            → status → 'Complete' or 'Failed'                     │
    73→│            → Creates generation records                          │
    74→│            → Triggers realtime updates                           │
    75→└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    76→```
    77→
    78→## API Param Naming Conventions
    79→
    80→| Context | Convention | Example |
    81→|---------|------------|---------|
    82→| API params (to backend) | `snake_case` | `structure_video_path` |
    83→| React props (UI-only) | `camelCase` | `onStructureVideoChange` |
    84→| Config objects (API-bound) | `snake_case` fields | `structureVideoConfig.structure_video_path` |
    85→| Hook return values | `camelCase` wrapper | `structureVideoConfig` (contains snake_case fields) |
    86→
    87→**Why:** API-bound config objects use `snake_case` so they can be spread directly into the request payload without field-name conversion.
    88→
    89→### Adding a new API param
    90→
    91→| Step | Location |
    92→|------|----------|
    93→| 1. Add to API interface | `src/shared/lib/tasks/*.ts` (e.g., add field to `VideoStructureApiParams`) |
    94→| 2. Add default (if needed) | Same file, in the `DEFAULT_*` constant |
    95→| 3. Add to UI config | Hook file — TypeScript enforces via `extends` |
    96→| 4. Done | Param flows through automatically via spread |
    97→
    98→## Key Invariants
    99→
   100→- Every `task_type` string passed to `createTask()` should have a matching `task_types.name` row. Missing rows silently default to `run_type='gpu'`.
   101→- Task helpers in `src/shared/lib/tasks/` own all validation and payload construction. The edge function is intentionally thin.
   102→- The `create-task` edge function never transforms params — it stores them as-is in `tasks.params`.
   103→- Authentication order matters: Service Role > JWT > PAT. First match wins.
   104→- `generateTaskId()` creates a prefixed UUID stored in `tasks.params`, not as the DB primary key.
   105→
   106→## Error Handling
   107→
   108→Errors follow the patterns in `error_handling.md`. Common categories:
   109→
   110→| Error Type | Cause |
   111→|------------|-------|
   112→| Validation | Missing/invalid params (caught client-side in task helper) |
   113→| Authentication | Missing or invalid token in edge function |
   114→| Authorization | User doesn't own the target project |
   115→| Database | Constraint violations on INSERT |
   116→
```

     2→import { isAbortError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→import { AuthError, NetworkError, ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     5→import { readAccessTokenFromStorage } from '@/shared/lib/supabaseSession';
     6→import { generateUUID } from './ids';
     7→import { parseTaskCreationResponse } from './parseTaskCreationResponse';
     8→import type { BaseTaskParams, TaskCreationResult } from './types';
     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Creates a task using the unified create-task edge function.
    12→ */
    13→export async function createTask(taskParams: BaseTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    14→  // Read access token from localStorage — avoids navigator.locks contention.
    15→  // getSession() acquires a shared navigator.lock blocked during token refresh.
    16→  const [REDACTED]();
    17→
    18→  if (!accessToken) {
    19→    throw new AuthError('Please log in to create tasks', { needsLogin: true });
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  const startTime = Date.now();
    23→  const requestId = `${startTime}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    24→  const requestContext = {
    25→    requestId,
    26→    taskType: taskParams.task_type,
    27→    projectId: taskParams.project_id,
    28→  };
    29→  const timeoutMs = 20000; // 20s safety timeout to avoid indefinite UI stall
    30→  const controller = new AbortController();
    31→  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    32→    controller.abort();
    33→  }, timeoutMs);
    34→
    35→  try {
    36→    // Generate an idempotency key to prevent duplicate task creation from
    37→    // network retries or double-clicks. The server will return the existing
    38→    // task if this key was already used.
    39→    const idempotency_key = generateUUID();
    40→
    41→    const response = await fetch(`${getSupabaseUrl()}/functions/v1/create-task`, {
    42→      method: 'POST',
    43→      headers: {
    44→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    45→        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
    46→        [REDACTED](),
    47→      },
    48→      body: JSON.stringify({
    49→        params: taskParams.params,
    50→        task_type: taskParams.task_type,
    51→        project_id: taskParams.project_id,
    52→        dependant_on: null,
    53→        idempotency_key,
    54→      }),
    55→      signal: controller.signal,
    56→    });
    57→
    58→    if (!response.ok) {
    59→      const errorText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    60→      throw new ServerError(errorText || 'Failed to create task', {
    61→        context: requestContext,
    62→      });
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    const data = await response.json() as unknown;
    66→    return parseTaskCreationResponse(data, requestContext);
    67→  } catch (err: unknown) {
    68→    const context = {
    69→      requestId,
    70→      taskType: taskParams.task_type,
    71→      projectId: taskParams.project_id,
    72→      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    73→    };
    74→
    75→    if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
    76→      console.error('[createTask] invoke FAILED', context, err);
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    // Normalize abort errors for better UX
    80→    if (isAbortError(err)) {
    81→      throw new NetworkError('Task creation timed out. Please try again.', {
    82→        isTimeout: true,
    83→        context,
    84→        cause: err instanceof Error ? err : undefined,
    85→      });
    86→    }
    87→
    88→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(err, {
    89→      context: 'TaskCreation',
    90→      showToast: false,
    91→      logData: context,
    92→    });
    93→  } finally {
    94→    clearTimeout(timeout);
    95→  }
    96→}
    97→

    36→/**
    37→ * Calculates the final resolution for image generation tasks.
    38→ * Applies user-configurable scaling for supported image generation models.
    39→ */
    40→async function calculateTaskResolution(
    41→  options: CalculateTaskResolutionOptions,
    42→): Promise<string> {
    43→  const { projectId, resolution_scale, resolution_mode, custom_aspect_ratio } = options;
    44→
    45→  if (options.customResolution?.trim()) {
    46→    return options.customResolution.trim();
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const baseResolution = (() => {
    50→    if (resolution_mode === 'custom' && custom_aspect_ratio) {
    51→      return ASPECT_RATIO_TO_RESOLUTION[custom_aspect_ratio] ?? '902x508';
    52→    }
    53→    return null;
    54→  })();
    55→
    56→  const resolvedBaseResolution = baseResolution
    57→    ?? (await resolveProjectResolution(projectId)).resolution;
    58→
    59→  const isImageGenerationModel = options.modelName === 'qwen-image'
    60→    || options.modelName === 'qwen-image-2512'
    61→    || options.modelName === 'z-image';
    62→
    63→  if (isImageGenerationModel) {
    64→    const scale = resolution_scale ?? 1.5;
    65→    const [width, height] = resolvedBaseResolution.split('x').map(Number);
    66→    return `${Math.round(width * scale)}x${Math.round(height * scale)}`;
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  return resolvedBaseResolution;
    70→}
    71→

    74→/**
    75→ * Creates a single image generation task using the unified approach.
    76→ */
    77→async function createImageGenerationTask(
    78→  params: ImageGenerationTaskParams,
    79→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    80→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
    81→    params,
    82→    context: 'ImageGeneration',
    83→    validate: validateImageGenerationParams,
    84→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
    85→      const finalResolution = await calculateTaskResolution({
    86→        projectId: requestParams.project_id,
    87→        customResolution: requestParams.resolution,
    88→        modelName: requestParams.model_name,
    89→      });
    90→
    91→      const taskType = (() => {
    92→        const modelName = requestParams.model_name;
    93→        const hasStyleRef = !!requestParams.style_reference_image;
    94→        switch (modelName) {
    95→          case 'qwen-image':
    96→            return hasStyleRef ? 'qwen_image_style' : 'qwen_image';
    97→          case 'qwen-image-2512':
    98→            return 'qwen_image_2512';
    99→          case 'z-image':
   100→            return 'z_image_turbo';
   101→          default:
   102→            return 'wan_2_2_t2i';
   103→        }
   104→      })();
   105→
   106→      const supportsReferenceParamsModel =
   107→        requestParams.model_name?.startsWith('qwen-image') || requestParams.model_name === 'z-image';
   108→      const taskId = generateTaskId(taskType);
   109→
   110→      const lorasParam = buildLorasParam(
   111→        requestParams.loras,
   112→        supportsReferenceParamsModel && requestParams.in_this_scene && requestParams.in_this_scene_strength
   113→          ? { url: IN_SCENE_LORA_URL, strength: requestParams.in_this_scene_strength }
   114→          : undefined,
   115→      );
   116→
   117→      const referenceParams = supportsReferenceParamsModel
   118→        ? buildReferenceParams(requestParams.style_reference_image, requestParams.reference_mode, {
   119→            subjectReferenceImage: requestParams.subject_reference_image,
   120→            styleReferenceStrength: requestParams.style_reference_strength ?? 1.0,
   121→            subjectStrength: requestParams.subject_strength ?? 0.0,
   122→            subjectDescription: requestParams.subject_description,
   123→            inThisScene: requestParams.in_this_scene,
   124→            inThisSceneStrength: requestParams.in_this_scene_strength,
   125→          })
   126→        : {};
   127→
   128→      const hiresOverride = buildHiresOverride(
   129→        requestParams.hires_scale,
   130→        requestParams.hires_denoise,
   131→        requestParams.hires_steps,
   132→        requestParams.additional_loras,
   133→        lorasParam.additional_loras,
   134→      );
   135→
   136→      const taskParamsToSend = composeTaskParams({
   137→        source: requestParams,
   138→        baseParams: buildImageGenerationBaseParams(requestParams, taskId, finalResolution),
   139→        segments: [lorasParam, referenceParams, hiresOverride],
   140→        mappedFields: [
   141→          {
   142→            from: 'shot_id',
   143→            include: (value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0,
   144→          },
   145→          { from: 'lightning_lora_strength_phase_1' },
   146→          { from: 'lightning_lora_strength_phase_2' },
   147→        ],
   148→      });
   149→
   150→      return composeTaskRequest({
   151→        source: requestParams,
   152→        taskType,
   153→        params: taskParamsToSend,
   154→      });
   155→    },
   156→  });
   157→}

   159→/**
   160→ * Creates multiple image generation tasks in parallel (batch generation).
   161→ */
   162→export async function createBatchImageGenerationTasks(
   163→  params: BatchImageGenerationTaskParams,
   164→): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   165→  try {
   166→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   167→      batchParams: params,
   168→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchImageGenerationParams,
   169→      buildSingleTaskParams: async (batchParams): Promise<ImageGenerationTaskParams[]> => {
   170→        const finalResolution = await calculateTaskResolution({
   171→          projectId: batchParams.project_id,
   172→          customResolution: batchParams.resolution,
   173→          modelName: batchParams.model_name,
   174→          resolution_scale: batchParams.resolution_scale,
   175→          resolution_mode: batchParams.resolution_mode,
   176→          custom_aspect_ratio: batchParams.custom_aspect_ratio,
   177→        });
   178→
   179→        const batchReferenceParams = buildReferenceParams(
   180→          batchParams.style_reference_image,
   181→          batchParams.reference_mode,
   182→          {
   183→            subjectReferenceImage: batchParams.subject_reference_image,
   184→            styleReferenceStrength: batchParams.style_reference_strength,
   185→            subjectStrength: batchParams.subject_strength,
   186→            subjectDescription: batchParams.subject_description,
   187→            inThisScene: batchParams.in_this_scene,
   188→            inThisSceneStrength: batchParams.in_this_scene_strength,
   189→          },
   190→        );
   191→
   192→        return batchParams.prompts.flatMap((promptEntry) => (
   193→          Array.from({ length: batchParams.imagesPerPrompt }, () => {
   194→            const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
   195→            return {
   196→              project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   197→              prompt: promptEntry.fullPrompt,
   198→              resolution: finalResolution,
   199→              seed,

   202→              model_name: batchParams.model_name,
   203→              steps: batchParams.steps,
   204→              reference_mode: batchParams.reference_mode,
   205→              ...batchReferenceParams,
   206→              ...composeOptionalFields([
   207→                { key: 'hires_scale', value: batchParams.hires_scale },
   208→                { key: 'hires_steps', value: batchParams.hires_steps },

   217→              ]),

    10→export interface MaskedEditTaskParams {

    22→  hires_fix?: HiresFixApiParams;

    26→interface MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig {
    27→  taskType: 'image_inpaint' | 'annotated_image_edit';
    28→  context: string;
    29→  batchOperationName: string;
    30→}
    31→
    32→async function createSingleMaskedEditTask(
    33→  config: MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig,
    34→  params: Omit<MaskedEditTaskParams, 'num_generations'>,
    35→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    36→  const {
    37→    image_url,
    38→    mask_url,
    39→    prompt,
    40→    generation_id,
    41→    shot_id,
    42→    tool_type,
    43→    loras,
    44→    create_as_generation,
    45→    source_variant_id,
    46→    hires_fix,
    47→    qwen_edit_model,
    48→  } = params;
    49→
    50→  const taskParams = composeTaskParams({
    51→    source: params,
    52→    baseParams: {
    53→      image_url,
    54→      mask_url,
    55→      prompt,
    56→      num_generations: 1,
    57→      generation_id,
    58→      based_on: generation_id,
    59→      parent_generation_id: generation_id,
    60→    },
    61→    segments: [
    62→      shot_id ? { shot_id } : undefined,
    63→      tool_type ? { tool_type } : undefined,
    64→      loras && loras.length > 0 ? { loras } : undefined,
    65→      create_as_generation ? { create_as_generation: true } : undefined,
    66→      source_variant_id ? { source_variant_id } : undefined,
    67→      buildHiresFixParams(hires_fix),
    68→      qwen_edit_model ? { qwen_edit_model } : undefined,
    69→    ],
    70→  });
    71→
    72→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
    73→    params,
    74→    context: config.context,
    75→    buildTaskRequest: (pipelineParams) => composeTaskRequest({
    76→      source: pipelineParams,
    77→      taskType: config.taskType,
    78→      params: taskParams,
    79→    }),
    80→  });
    81→}
    82→
    83→export async function createMaskedEditTask(
    84→  config: MaskedEditTaskBuilderConfig,
    85→  params: MaskedEditTaskParams,
    86→): Promise<string> {
    87→  const { num_generations, ...singleTaskParams } = params;
    88→
    89→  if (num_generations === 1) {
    90→    const result = await createSingleMaskedEditTask(config, singleTaskParams);
    91→    return result.task_id;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    95→    Array.from({ length: num_generations }, () => createSingleMaskedEditTask(config, singleTaskParams)),
    96→  );
    97→
    98→  const successful = processBatchResults(results, config.batchOperationName);
    99→  return successful[0].task_id;
   100→}

    14→import type { BrushStroke, EditAdvancedSettings, QwenEditModel } from './types';
    15→
    16→import { convertToHiresFixApiParams } from '../useGenerationEditSettings';
    17→import { getGenerationId, getMediaUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
    18→import { useTaskPlaceholder } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTaskPlaceholder';
    19→
    20→/**
    21→ * Task type configuration - captures the differences between inpaint and annotate modes
    22→ */
    23→type TaskType = 'inpaint' | 'annotate';
    24→
    25→interface TaskTypeConfig {
    26→  logPrefix: string;
    27→  emptyStrokesError: string;
    28→  overlayNotReadyError: string;
    29→  fileNamePrefix: string;
    30→  taskCreationError: string;
    31→  createTask: typeof createImageInpaintTask | typeof createAnnotatedImageEditTask;
    32→}
    33→
    34→const TASK_CONFIGS: Record<TaskType, TaskTypeConfig> = {
    35→  inpaint: {
    36→    logPrefix: '[Inpaint]',
    37→    emptyStrokesError: 'Please paint on the image first',
    38→    overlayNotReadyError: 'Paint overlay not ready',
    39→    fileNamePrefix: 'inpaint_mask',
    40→    taskCreationError: 'Failed to create inpaint task',
    41→    createTask: createImageInpaintTask,
    42→  },
    43→  annotate: {
    44→    logPrefix: '[AnnotateEdit]',
    45→    emptyStrokesError: 'Please draw an annotation rectangle',
    46→    overlayNotReadyError: 'Annotation overlay not ready',
    47→    fileNamePrefix: 'annotated_edit_mask',
    48→    taskCreationError: 'Failed to create annotated edit task',
    49→    createTask: createAnnotatedImageEditTask,
    50→  },
    51→};
    52→
    53→interface UseTaskGenerationProps {
    54→  media: GenerationRow;
    55→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    56→  shotId?: string;
    57→  toolTypeOverride?: string;
    58→  isVideo: boolean;
    59→  loras?: Array<{ url: string; strength: number }>;
    60→  activeVariantId?: string | null;
    61→  activeVariantLocation?: string | null;
    62→  createAsGeneration?: boolean;
    63→  advancedSettings?: EditAdvancedSettings;
    64→  qwenEditModel?: QwenEditModel;
    65→  // State
    66→  inpaintStrokes: BrushStroke[];
    67→  annotationStrokes: BrushStroke[];
    68→  inpaintPrompt: string;
    69→  inpaintNumGenerations: number;
    70→  // Refs
    71→  strokeOverlayRef: React.RefObject<StrokeOverlayHandle>;
    72→  // Callbacks
    73→  handleExitInpaintMode: () => void;
    74→  setIsGeneratingInpaint: (isGenerating: boolean) => void;
    75→  setInpaintGenerateSuccess: (success: boolean) => void;
    76→}
    77→
    78→export function useTaskGeneration({
    79→  media,
    80→  selectedProjectId,
    81→  shotId,
    82→  toolTypeOverride,
    83→  isVideo,
    84→  loras,
    85→  activeVariantId,
    86→  activeVariantLocation,
    87→  createAsGeneration,
    88→  advancedSettings,
    89→  qwenEditModel,
    90→  inpaintStrokes,
    91→  annotationStrokes,
    92→  inpaintPrompt,
    93→  inpaintNumGenerations,
    94→  strokeOverlayRef,
    95→  handleExitInpaintMode,
    96→  setIsGeneratingInpaint,
    97→  setInpaintGenerateSuccess,
    98→}: UseTaskGenerationProps) {
    99→  // Get actual generation ID (may differ from media.id for shot_generations)
   100→  const actualGenerationId = getGenerationId(media);
   101→  const run = useTaskPlaceholder();
   102→
   103→  /**
   104→   * Unified task generation function
   105→   * Handles both inpaint and annotate modes with mode-specific configuration
   106→   */
   107→  const handleGenerateTask = useCallback(async (taskType: TaskType) => {
   108→    const config = TASK_CONFIGS[taskType];
   109→    const strokes = taskType === 'inpaint' ? inpaintStrokes : annotationStrokes;
   110→
   111→    // Validation
   112→    if (!selectedProjectId || isVideo) {
   113→      toast.error(`Cannot generate ${taskType === 'inpaint' ? 'inpaint' : 'annotated edit'}`);
   114→      return;
   115→    }
   116→
   117→    if (strokes.length === 0) {
   118→      toast.error(config.emptyStrokesError);
   119→      return;
   120→    }
   121→
   122→    if (!inpaintPrompt.trim()) {
   123→      toast.error('Please enter a prompt');
   124→      return;
   125→    }
   126→
   127→    if (!strokeOverlayRef.current) {
   128→      toast.error(config.overlayNotReadyError);
   129→      return;
   130→    }
   131→
   132→    const incomingTaskType = taskType === 'inpaint' ? 'image_inpaint' : 'annotated_image_edit';
   133→
   134→    setIsGeneratingInpaint(true);
   135→    try {
   136→      await run({
   137→        taskType: incomingTaskType,
   138→        label: inpaintPrompt.trim() || 'Editing...',
   139→        context: 'useTaskGeneration',
   140→        toastTitle: config.taskCreationError,
   141→        create: async () => {
   142→          // Export mask directly from Konva
   143→          const maskImageData = strokeOverlayRef.current!.exportMask({ pixelRatio: 1.5 });
   144→
   145→          if (!maskImageData) {
   146→            throw new Error('Failed to export mask from overlay');
   147→          }
   148→
   149→          // Upload mask to storage
   150→          const maskFile = await fetch(maskImageData)
   151→            .then(res => res.blob())
   152→            .then(blob => new File([blob], `${config.fileNamePrefix}_${media.id}_${Date.now()}.png`, { type: 'image/png' }));
   153→
   154→          const maskUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(maskFile);
   155→
   156→          // Get source image URL
   157→          const mediaUrl = getMediaUrl(media) || media.imageUrl;
   158→          const sourceUrl = activeVariantLocation || mediaUrl;
   159→          if (!sourceUrl) {
   160→            throw new Error('Missing source media URL');
   161→          }
   162→          if (!actualGenerationId) {
   163→            throw new Error('Missing generation id');
   164→          }
   165→
   166→          return config.createTask(
   167→            buildMaskedEditTaskParams({
   168→              projectId: selectedProjectId,
   169→              imageUrl: sourceUrl,
   170→              maskUrl,
   171→              prompt: inpaintPrompt,
   172→              numGenerations: inpaintNumGenerations,
   173→              generationId: actualGenerationId ?? undefined,
   174→              shotId,
   175→              toolType: toolTypeOverride,
   176→              loras,
   177→              createAsGeneration,
   178→              sourceVariantId: activeVariantId || undefined,
   179→              hiresFix: convertToHiresFixApiParams(advancedSettings),
   180→              qwenEditModel,
   181→            }),
   182→          );
   183→        },
   184→        onSuccess: () => {
   185→          // Show success state
   186→          setInpaintGenerateSuccess(true);
   187→
   188→          // Wait 1 second to show success, then exit
   189→          setTimeout(() => {
   190→            setInpaintGenerateSuccess(false);
   191→            handleExitInpaintMode();
   192→          }, 1000);
   193→        },
   194→      });
   195→    } finally {
   196→      setIsGeneratingInpaint(false);
   197→    }
   198→  }, [
   199→    selectedProjectId, isVideo, inpaintStrokes, annotationStrokes, inpaintPrompt, inpaintNumGenerations,
   200→    media, handleExitInpaintMode, shotId, toolTypeOverride, loras,

1→import { createTask, type BaseTaskParams, type TaskCreationResult } from '@/shared/lib/taskCreation';
     2→import { rethrowTaskCreationError } from './taskCreationError';
     3→
     4→interface TaskCreationPipelineConfig<TParams, TResult = TaskCreationResult> {
     5→  params: TParams;
     6→  context: string;
     7→  validate?: (params: TParams) => void;
     8→  buildTaskRequest: (params: TParams) => Promise<BaseTaskParams> | BaseTaskParams;
     9→  onCreated?: (result: TaskCreationResult, params: TParams) => Promise<TResult> | TResult;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export async function runTaskCreationPipeline<TParams, TResult = TaskCreationResult>(
    13→  config: TaskCreationPipelineConfig<TParams, TResult>,
    14→): Promise<TResult> {
    15→  const { params, context, validate, buildTaskRequest, onCreated } = config;
    16→
    17→  try {
    18→    validate?.(params);
    19→    const taskRequest = await buildTaskRequest(params);
    20→    const createdTask = await createTask(taskRequest);
    21→    if (!onCreated) {
    22→      return createdTask as TResult;
    23→    }
    24→    return await onCreated(createdTask, params);
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    rethrowTaskCreationError(error, { context, showToast: false });
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→

1→import type { BaseTaskParams } from '../taskCreation';
     2→import {
     3→  assignMappedPayloadFields,
     4→  type PayloadFieldMapping,
     5→} from '../taskCreation/payloadMapping';
     6→
     7→type PayloadSegment = Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
     8→
     9→interface ComposeTaskParamsInput<TSource extends object> {
    10→  source: TSource;
    11→  baseParams?: Record<string, unknown>;
    12→  segments?: readonly PayloadSegment[];
    13→  mappedFields?: readonly PayloadFieldMapping<TSource>[];
    14→}
    15→
    16→interface ComposeTaskRequestInput<TSource extends { project_id: string }> {
    17→  source: TSource;
    18→  taskType: string;
    19→  params: Record<string, unknown>;
    20→}
    21→
    22→/**
    23→ * Shared task-payload composition primitive used across task families.
    24→ */
    25→export function composeTaskParams<TSource extends object>(
    26→  input: ComposeTaskParamsInput<TSource>,
    27→): Record<string, unknown> {
    28→  const composed: Record<string, unknown> = {
    29→    ...(input.baseParams ?? {}),
    30→  };
    31→
    32→  for (const segment of input.segments ?? []) {
    33→    if (segment && typeof segment === 'object') {
    34→      Object.assign(composed, segment);
    35→    }
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  if (input.mappedFields && input.mappedFields.length > 0) {
    39→    assignMappedPayloadFields(composed, input.source, input.mappedFields);
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  return composed;
    43→}
    44→
    45→export function composeTaskRequest<TSource extends { project_id: string }>(
    46→  input: ComposeTaskRequestInput<TSource>,
    47→): BaseTaskParams {
    48→  return {
    49→    project_id: input.source.project_id,
    50→    task_type: input.taskType,
    51→    params: input.params,
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→

## Task Creation System - Complete Analysis

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's how task creation works across different tool types:

### Architecture Overview

**Single `createTask()` Function** - Yes, there is ONE unified entry point:
- Location: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/lib/taskCreation/createTask.ts`
- All tasks (regardless of type) go through this single function
- It calls the `create-task` edge function with `BaseTaskParams`
- Returns `{ task_id: string; status: string }`

**The Core Data Structure:**
```typescript
interface BaseTaskParams {
  project_id: string;
  task_type: TaskType;  // e.g., 'individual_travel_segment', 'annotated_image_edit', 'qwen_image'
  params: TaskParams;   // Raw payload dict - everything else goes here
}
```

The edge function does no transformation - it stores `params` as-is in the database.

---

### Task Creation Flow (All Types)

Every task follows this 3-stage pipeline:

```
UI Component/Hook
  ↓ [Task Helper in src/shared/lib/tasks/*.ts]
  ├─ Validate params
  └─ Build payload (compose task params + map fields)
  ↓ [runTaskCreationPipeline]
    ├─ Call buildTaskRequest() → BaseTaskParams
    └─ Call createTask(BaseTaskParams)
  ↓ [createTask() in taskCreation/createTask.ts]
    ├─ Read JWT from localStorage
    ├─ POST to /functions/v1/create-task
    ├─ Handle timeout/network errors
    └─ Return TaskCreationResult
  ↓ [Edge Function]
    ├─ Authenticate (JWT → user_id)
    ├─ INSERT into tasks table
    └─ DB trigger sets run_type from task_types table
```

---

### 1. IMAGE GENERATION (Travel Between Images)

**Entry Point:** `createIndividualTravelSegmentTask()`  
**Location:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/lib/tasks/individualTravelSegment.ts`

**Caller Chain:**
1. UI: `SegmentRegenerateForm.tsx` or `SegmentSlotFormView.tsx` (forms)
2. → `submitSegmentTask()` helper in `src/domains/media-lightbox/components/submitSegmentTask.ts`
3. → `createIndividualTravelSegmentTask()`

**What Gets Passed to `createTask()`:**

```typescript
BaseTaskParams {
  project_id: string
  task_type: 'individual_travel_segment'
  params: {
    // Travel-specific payload
    prompt: string
    enhanced_prompt?: string
    negative_prompt?: string
    num_frames: number
    model_name: string
    resolution: string
    motion_mode: string
    amount_of_motion?: number
    segment_index: number
    parent_generation_id?: string
    child_generation_id?: string
    shot_id?: string
    pair_shot_generation_id?: string
    start_image_url: string
    end_image_url?: string
    
    // Optional structure guidance
    structure_guidance?: {
      videos: Array<{
        path: string
        start_frame: number
        end_frame: number
        treatment: 'adjust' | 'clip'
      }>
      controls: { ... }
    }
    
    // Optional lineage tracking
    based_on?: string
    source_variant_id?: string
    
    // LoRAs if applicable
    additional_loras?: Record<string, string>
  }
}
```

**UI-Specific vs Data-Specific Logic:**
- **UI-specific:** Prompt enhancement (calls `ai-prompt` edge function), metadata saving, task placeholder management (optimistic UI)
- **Data-specific:** Resolution resolution, structure guidance building, task payload composition
- The function `buildTaskParams()` in `segmentTaskPayload.ts` handles all data building
- `submitSegmentTask()` is pure orchestration - it coordinates UI lifecycle (placeholder, enhancement, metadata) but calls task creation cleanly

**Key Params Each Passes:**
- SegmentRegenerateForm: All form settings (resolution, motion, segment frames, etc.) + image URLs
- submitSegmentTask: Adds prompt affixes (text_before/after), handles enhancement, builds final params
- createIndividualTravelSegmentTask: Validates and wraps in BaseTaskParams

### 2. IMAGE GENERATION (Standalone/Batch)

**Entry Point:** `createBatchImageGenerationTasks()` or `createImageGenerationTask()`  
**Location:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/lib/tasks/imageGeneration.ts`

**Caller Chain:**
1. UI: `useImageGenSubmit()` hook in `src/tools/image-generation/hooks/useImageGenSubmit.ts`
2. → `createBatchImageGenerationTasks()`
3. → (internally calls `createImageGenerationTask()` for each item in batch via `Promise.allSettled`)

**What Gets Passed to `createTask()`:**

```typescript
BaseTaskParams {
  project_id: string
  task_type: 'qwen_image' | 'qwen_image_style' | 'qwen_image_2512' | 'z_image_turbo' | 'wan_2_2_t2i'
  params: {
    // Base generation params
    prompt: string
    resolution: string
    seed: number
    model_name: string
    steps: number
    
    // Optional reference params (qwen/z-image models)
    reference_mode?: string
    style_reference_image?: string
    style_reference_strength?: number
    subject_reference_image?: string
    subject_strength?: number
    subject_description?: string
    
    // In-scene reference
    in_this_scene?: boolean
    in_this_scene_strength?: number
    
    // LoRAs
    loras?: Array<{ url: string; strength: number }>
    additional_loras?: Record<string, string>
    
    // Hires fix (two-pass mode)
    hires_scale?: number
    hires_steps?: number
    hires_denoise?: number
    
    // Lightning LoRA per-phase strengths
    lightning_lora_strength_phase_1?: number
    lightning_lora_strength_phase_2?: number
    
    // Lineage
    shot_id?: string
    based_on?: string  // variant source
    
    // Task tracking
    task_id: string  // prefixed UUID
  }
}
```

**UI-Specific vs Data-Specific Logic:**
- **UI-specific:** Batch looping, error reporting, query invalidation (project prefix)
- **Data-specific:** Model selection logic, resolution scaling, LoRA composition, reference building, hires override building
- `composeTaskParams()` merges: baseParams + lorasParam + referenceParams + hiresOverride + mapped fields
- No prompt enhancement or metadata saving - pure generation requests

**Key Params Each Passes:**
- UI Form: All checkboxes, dropdowns, reference selections
- useImageGenSubmit: Loops batch items, calls createBatch*
- createImageGeneration: Calculates resolution, picks task_type based on model, composes final params

### 3. IMAGE EDIT (Annotated/Inpaint)

**Entry Point:** `createAnnotatedImageEditTask()` or `createImageInpaintTask()`  
**Location:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/lib/tasks/annotatedImageEdit.ts` and `maskedEditTaskBuilder.ts`

**Caller Chain:**
1. UI: `useInpainting()` hook in `src/domains/media-lightbox/hooks/useInpainting.ts`
2. → `useTaskGeneration()` sub-hook
3. → (exports mask from Konva canvas) → uploads to storage
4. → `createAnnotatedImageEditTask()` or `createImageInpaintTask()`
5. → (both delegate to) `createMaskedEditTask()` in `maskedEditTaskBuilder.ts`

**What Gets Passed to `createTask()`:**

```typescript
BaseTaskParams {
  project_id: string
  task_type: 'annotated_image_edit' | 'image_inpaint'
  params: {
    // Mask + image
    image_url: string           // Source image URL
    mask_url: string            // Uploaded mask file URL
    prompt: string              // Edit prompt
    num_generations: number
    
    // Lineage
    generation_id?: string      // Source generation
    based_on?: string           // Variant source (same as generation_id)
    parent_generation_id?: string
    source_variant_id?: string  // Variant ID if editing from non-primary
    create_as_generation?: boolean
    
    // Context
    shot_id?: string
    tool_type?: string
    
    // LoRAs
    loras?: Array<{ url: string; strength: number }>
    
    // Hires fix
    hires_fix?: {
      num_inference_steps?: number
      hires_scale?: number
      hires_steps?: number
      hires_denoise?: number
      lightning_lora_strength_phase_1?: number
      lightning_lora_strength_phase_2?: number
      additional_loras?: Record<string, string>
    }
    
    // Model selection
    qwen_edit_model?: 'qwen-edit' | 'qwen-edit-2509' | 'qwen-edit-2511'
  }
}
```

**UI-Specific vs Data-Specific Logic:**
- **UI-specific:** Mask export from Konva, mask upload to storage, task placeholder, success animation (1s timeout), UI exit callback
- **Data-specific:** Mask file creation, URL resolution, lineage field mapping
- Mask export happens BEFORE task creation (in the hook's `create` callback)
- `buildMaskedEditTaskParams()` is trivial - mostly 1:1 field mapping with camelCase→snake_case

**Key Params Each Passes:**
- useInpainting state: strokes/rectangles, prompt, num generations
- useTaskGeneration: Exports mask, uploads it, gets generation ID, calls createTask
- createMaskedEditTask: Loops num_generations times (each calls createSingleMaskedEditTask)
- createAnnotatedImageEditTask: Just wraps createMaskedEditTask with taskType='annotated_image_edit'

---

### Shared Composition Utilities

**`composeTaskParams()`** in `taskRequestComposer.ts` - Used by image generation and masked edit:
```typescript
composeTaskParams({
  source: inputParams,
  baseParams: { ... core fields ... },
  segments: [ lorasSegment, referenceSegment, hiresSegment, ... ],
  mappedFields: [ 
    { from: 'shot_id', include: (v) => ... },
    { from: 'lightning_lora_strength_phase_1' },
  ]
})
```
Merges: baseParams + segments + mapped fields from source.

**`runTaskCreationPipeline()`** in `taskCreatorPipeline.ts` - Used by all:
```typescript
runTaskCreationPipeline({
  params: inputParams,
  context: 'ImageGeneration',
  validate: validateFn,
  buildTaskRequest: async (p) => BaseTaskParams,
  onCreated?: (result, params) => TResult
})
```
Validates → builds request → calls createTask → optionally transforms result.

---

### Auth Flow (Unified)

All three go through the same `createTask()` function:
1. **Read JWT from localStorage** (avoids navigator.locks contention)
2. **POST to `/functions/v1/create-task`** with:
   - `Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}`
   - `Content-Type: application/json`
   - Idempotency key (UUID)
3. **Edge function authenticates** (JWT → `user_id`)
4. **DB trigger** looks up `task_types.name` → sets `run_type` (gpu/api)

**Error Handling:**
- Timeout: 20s (aborted if EF doesn't respond)
- Network error → `NetworkError`
- Auth error → `AuthError`
- Server error → `ServerError`
- All caught + normalized by `normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow()`
- **No success toasts** (per convention)

---

### Key Invariants

| Invariant | Where Enforced | Why |
|-----------|----------------|-----|
| `project_id` always set | Task helpers validate | Required for auth/billing |
| `task_type` matches `task_types.name` | DB trigger (silent default to 'gpu' if missing) | Determines worker pool |
| Params stored as-is, no EF transformation | Edge function reads-only | Worker gets original intent |
| LoRAs as URL+strength objects | Task helpers compose | Consistent format across models |
| `based_on` ≈ `parent_generation_id` for edits | Explicit field mapping | Both used for lineage tracking |
| Mask uploaded BEFORE task created | Hook callback order | URL must be valid |
| Segment resolution calculated client-side | Task helper | Project defaults + scaling applied upfront |
| Enhanced prompt saved to shot_generations metadata | submitSegmentTask (non-fatal) | Metadata persisted separately from task params |

---

|---------|---|---|---|
| **Main Function** | `createIndividualTravelSegmentTask` | `createBatchImageGenerationTasks` | `createAnnotatedImageEditTask` |
| **Task Type Param** | `'individual_travel_segment'` | `'qwen_image'` \| `'z_image_turbo'` \| etc. | `'annotated_image_edit'` |
| **Caller Context** | Lightbox segment form (SegmentRegenerateForm) | Image gen tool hook (useImageGenSubmit) | Lightbox edit mode (useInpainting→useTaskGeneration) |
| **UI Logic Handled** | Prompt enhancement (async), metadata save, task placeholder | Batch looping, query invalidation | Mask export, mask upload, exit animation |
| **Data Logic** | Resolution from project, structure guidance build, segment params build | Model selection, resolution scaling, LoRA merge, reference params | Lineage field mapping (mostly 1:1) |
| **Batch Support** | No (single segment per call) | Yes (Promise.allSettled over items) | Yes (num_generations creates N tasks sequentially) |
| **Mask/Media Upload** | None (uses image URLs from DB) | None (uses URLs from DB) | Yes (mask exported from Konva, uploaded to storage, URL passed to task) |
| **Composition Helper** | `buildTaskParams()` (custom builder) | `composeTaskParams()` (segments + mapped) | `composeTaskParams()` (simple 1:1 + hiresFix segment) |

1→# Task & Worker Lifecycle
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→Reigh uses an async task queue pattern for all AI generation workloads. This decouples the UI from long-running operations and enables distributed processing.
     6→
     7→## Flow Diagram
     8→
     9→### High-Level Overview
    10→```
    11→┌─────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐
    12→│ Client  │────▶│ create_task  │────▶│   DB    │◀────│   Worker   │
    13→│   UI    │     │ Edge Function│     │ (tasks) │     │  (Express) │
    14→└─────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘     └────────────┘
    15→     ▲                                      │                 │
    16→     │                                      │                 │
    17→     │          ┌──────────────┐           │                 │
    18→     └──────────│   Realtime   │◀──────────┴─────────────────┘
    19→                │  Broadcast   │         (status updates)
    20→                └──────────────┘
    21→```
    22→
    23→## Detailed Steps
    24→
    25→### 1. Task Creation
    26→- Client calls `/supabase/functions/create_task` with:
    27→  - `tool_id` (e.g., 'image-generation')
    28→  - `input` (tool-specific parameters)
    29→  - `cost` (pre-calculated credits)
    30→- Edge Function validates user has sufficient credits
    31→- Inserts row into `tasks` table with `status = 'Queued'`
    32→- Returns task ID to client
    33→
    34→### 2. Worker Polling & Task Processing
    35→- **External Workers** (Headless-Wan2GP) poll via `claim_next_task` Edge Function:
    36→  - Uses **model affinity**: prefers tasks matching worker's `current_model` to avoid model reloads
    37→  - Falls back to FIFO (oldest first) if no model match or worker hasn't reported a model
    38→  - Updates to `In Progress` with `worker_id`
    39→  - Returns task details
    40→- **Model Tracking**: Workers call `update-worker-model` after loading a model to enable affinity matching
    41→- **Task Processing** now uses **Database Triggers** (instant):
    42→  - When task status → `Complete`: SQL trigger `create_generation_on_task_complete` runs
    43→  - Creates generations and shot_generations automatically in the database
    44→  - Normalizes image paths and handles all edge cases
    45→  - Broadcasts real-time updates via Supabase Realtime
    46→- Worker processes based on `tool_id`:
    47→  - Image generation → FAL API
    48→  - Video processing → FFmpeg
    49→  - Prompt enhancement → OpenAI
    50→
    51→## Worker Types
    52→
    53→### Local Express Worker
    54→- Basic task processor (`/src/server/services/taskProcessingService.ts`)
    55→- Handles simple tasks like prompt enhancement and basic image generation
    56→- Runs alongside the main application in development
    57→
    58→### Headless-Wan2GP Worker (Cloud/Local GPU)
    59→- Advanced video generation worker: [Headless-Wan2GP](https://github.com/peteromallet/Headless-Wan2GP)
    60→- Specialized for travel-between-images video generation tasks
    61→- Can run locally with GPU or deployed to cloud instances
    62→- Handles computationally intensive video generation workflows
    63→
    64→#### Task Types Handled
    65→- **`travel_orchestrator`** - Manages multi-segment travel workflows
    66→- **`travel_segment`** - Creates guide videos and runs WGP generation using VACE
    67→- **`travel_stitch`** - Stitches segment videos with crossfades and timing
    68→- **`individual_travel_segment`** - Standalone segment regeneration (visible in TasksPane, creates variant on parent generation)
    69→- **`image-generation`** - Fallback for basic image generation tasks
    70→
    71→#### Deployment Options
    72→
    73→**Local Deployment (GPU Required)**
    74→```bash
    75→# Clone the worker repository
    76→git clone https://github.com/peteromallet/Headless-Wan2GP.git
    77→cd Headless-Wan2GP
    78→
    79→# Install dependencies
    80→pip install -r requirements.txt
    81→
    82→# Configure environment
    83→cp .env.example .env
    84→# Edit .env with your Supabase credentials and API keys
    85→
    86→# Run the worker
    87→python main.py
    88→```
    89→
    90→**Cloud Deployment**
    91→- Deploy to GPU-enabled cloud instances (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.)
    92→- Requires CUDA-compatible GPU for video generation
    93→- Configure with production Supabase credentials
    94→- Multiple workers can run simultaneously for parallel processing
    95→
    96→#### Worker Configuration
    97→The worker polls the same task queue but specializes in video generation:
    98→- Connects to Supabase using environment credentials
    99→- Claims tasks with `tool_id` matching its capabilities
   100→- Updates task status and uploads results to designated storage buckets
   101→- Uses PostgreSQL (Supabase) for both local development and production
   102→
   103→### 3. Task Completion
   104→- Worker calls `complete_task` Edge Function with:
   105→  - Task ID
   106→  - Output data (URLs, metadata)
   107→  - Error info (if failed)
   108→- Edge Function:
   109→  - Updates task status using `func_mark_task_complete` or `func_mark_task_failed`
   110→  - Deducts credits from user's balance
   111→  - **Variant vs Generation Logic**: If task has `based_on` parameter, creates a `generation_variant` on the source generation. If `create_as_generation=true` flag is set, overrides this and creates a new `generation` with `based_on` for lineage tracking instead.
   112→- **SQL Trigger** (`create_generation_on_task_complete`):
   113→  - Automatically creates `generations` records when status → `Complete`
   114→  - Normalizes image paths (removes local server IPs)
   115→  - Creates `shot_generations` links if applicable
   116→  - All processing happens instantly in the database
   117→
   118→### 4. Real-time Updates
   119→- **Database Triggers** automatically broadcast changes via Supabase Realtime
   120→- **Instant processing** when tasks complete (no 10-second delay)
   121→- Client subscribes via the realtime system (`RealtimeProvider`; see [`realtime_system.md`](realtime_system.md))
   122→- UI updates automatically as task progresses
   123→
   124→## Debugging
   125→
   126→See [`debugging.md`](debugging.md) for full debugging tools (CLI, SQL views, frontend logging).
   127→
   128→For task-specific debugging: `cd scripts && python3 debug.py task <task_id>` shows the full timeline including trigger execution and generation creation.
```

     8→## Non-obvious Behavior
     9→
    10→| Function | Gotcha / Invariant |
    11→|----------|-------------------|
    12→| `complete_task` | Supports `create_as_generation` flag — forces a new generation instead of a variant even when `based_on` is present. Without it, `based_on` always creates a variant. |
    13→| `claim-next-task` | Uses **model affinity**: prefers queued tasks whose model matches the worker's currently loaded model, reducing cold-start swaps. |
    14→| `update-worker-model` | Workers report their loaded model here; this is what enables affinity matching in `claim-next-task`. |
    15→| `create-task` | Validates credit balance **before** inserting the task; task is created in `queued` status. |
    16→| `update-shot-pair-prompts` | Called by orchestrator tasks to write `pair_prompt` / `enhanced_prompt` back to `shot_generations` metadata. |
    17→
    18→## Authentication
    19→
    20→| Method | When to use |
    21→|--------|------------|
    22→| **PAT tokens** (`generate-pat` / `revoke-pat`) | External (local) workers — revocable, scoped to user. |
    23→| **Service Role key** | Cloud-based processing — higher privileges, rate-limited. |
    24→
    25→## Performance Notes
    26→
    27→- **Task completion** side-effects (generation creation, credit deduction) now run via **SQL triggers**, not Edge Functions. The Edge Function writes the result row; triggers do the rest.
    28→- Prefer DB functions / RPCs over multiple Edge Function calls for transactional work.
    29→
    30→## Integration Contracts
    31→
    32→- External workers must send payloads in **Headless-Wan2GP** format.
    33→- All task status changes broadcast via **Supabase Realtime** (primary freshness via realtime; smart polling as fallback).
    34→- Functions return standardized error JSON — see `error_handling.md`.
    35→
    36→---
    37→
    38→**Related**: [Task Worker Lifecycle](task_worker_lifecycle.md) | [Database & Storage](db_and_storage.md)
    39→

1→-- Create task_types table with run_type support
     2→-- This replaces task_cost_configs with enhanced metadata including run_type filtering
     3→
     4→-- =============================================================================
     5→-- 1. Create task_types table
     6→-- =============================================================================
     7→
     8→CREATE TABLE task_types (
     9→  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    10→  name text NOT NULL UNIQUE,                    -- e.g., 'single_image', 'travel_orchestrator'
    11→  run_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gpu',         -- 'gpu' | 'api' 
    12→  category text NOT NULL,                       -- 'generation', 'processing', 'orchestration', 'utility'
    13→  display_name text NOT NULL,
    14→  description text,
    15→  base_cost_per_second decimal(10,6) NOT NULL,  -- Base cost per second in decimal cents
    16→  cost_factors jsonb DEFAULT '{}',              -- Flexible cost factors configuration
    17→  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
    18→  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    19→  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
    20→);
    21→
    22→-- Create indexes for performance
    23→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_name ON task_types(name);
    24→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_run_type ON task_types(run_type);
    25→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_category ON task_types(category);
    26→CREATE INDEX idx_task_types_active ON task_types(is_active);
    27→
    28→-- Add constraint for run_type values
    29→ALTER TABLE task_types ADD CONSTRAINT check_run_type CHECK (run_type IN ('gpu', 'api'));
    30→
    31→-- =============================================================================
    32→-- 2. Migrate data from task_cost_configs (all as 'gpu' type)
    33→-- =============================================================================
    34→
    35→INSERT INTO task_types (name, run_type, category, display_name, description, base_cost_per_second, cost_factors, is_active) 
    36→SELECT 
    37→  tcc.task_type as name,
    38→  'gpu' as run_type,                           -- All existing tasks default to GPU
    39→  tcc.category,
    40→  tcc.display_name,
    41→  CASE 
    42→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'single_image' THEN 'Generate individual images using AI models'
    43→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'travel_stitch' THEN 'Stitch individual video segments into final output'
    44→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'travel_orchestrator' THEN 'Coordinate complex multi-step travel generation workflows'
    45→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'image_upscale' THEN 'Increase image resolution using AI upscaling'
    46→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'image_edit' THEN 'Edit and modify existing images using AI'
    47→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'lora_training' THEN 'Train custom LoRA models for personalized generation'
    48→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'travel_segment' THEN 'Generate individual video segments for travel sequences'
    49→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'edit_travel_kontext' THEN 'Edit travel sequences using Kontext model'
    50→    WHEN tcc.task_type = 'edit_travel_flux' THEN 'Edit travel sequences using Flux model'
    51→    ELSE 'AI processing task'
    52→  END as description,
    53→  tcc.base_cost_per_second,
    54→  tcc.cost_factors,
    55→  tcc.is_active
    56→FROM task_cost_configs tcc
    57→WHERE tcc.is_active = true;
    58→
    59→-- =============================================================================
    60→-- 3. Add helper function to get task run_type with fallback
    61→-- =============================================================================
    62→
    63→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_task_run_type(p_task_type text)
    64→RETURNS text
    65→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    66→SECURITY DEFINER
    67→AS $$
    68→DECLARE
    69→  v_run_type text;
    70→BEGIN
    71→  -- Look up run_type for the task_type
    72→  SELECT run_type INTO v_run_type
    73→  FROM task_types 
    74→  WHERE name = p_task_type AND is_active = true;
    75→  
    76→  -- If not found, default to 'gpu'
    77→  IF v_run_type IS NULL THEN
    78→    v_run_type := 'gpu';
    79→  END IF;
    80→  
    81→  RETURN v_run_type;
    82→END;
    83→$$;
    84→
    85→-- =============================================================================
    86→-- 4. Add comments
    87→-- =============================================================================
    88→
    89→COMMENT ON TABLE task_types IS 'Registry of all task types with their execution environment (gpu/api) and metadata';
    90→COMMENT ON COLUMN task_types.name IS 'Unique task type identifier (matches tasks.task_type)';
    91→COMMENT ON COLUMN task_types.run_type IS 'Execution environment: gpu (local/cloud GPU) or api (external API calls)';
    92→COMMENT ON COLUMN task_types.category IS 'Task category for organization and UI display';
    93→COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_task_run_type IS 'Helper function to get run_type for a task with gpu fallback';
    94→

   354→      follow_up_issue_count: completionFollowUpIssues.length,

   356→    await logger.flush();

   358→    return jsonResponse(responseData, 200);

     2→-- This supports the task claiming system that tracks which worker is processing a task
     3→
     4→-- Create workers table to track worker instances
     5→CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.workers (
     6→    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     7→    instance_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'edge', 'server', 'manual', etc.
     8→    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
     9→    last_heartbeat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
    10→    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive', 'terminated')),
    11→    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'
    12→);
    13→
    14→-- Add worker_id column to tasks table
    15→ALTER TABLE public.tasks 
    16→ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS worker_id TEXT REFERENCES public.workers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
    17→
    18→-- Create index for better query performance on worker_id
    19→CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_worker_id ON public.tasks(worker_id);
    20→
    21→-- Create index for worker status queries
    22→CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workers_status ON public.workers(status);
    23→CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workers_last_heartbeat ON public.workers(last_heartbeat);
    24→
    25→-- Enable RLS for workers table (if RLS is enabled globally)
    26→ALTER TABLE public.workers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    27→
    28→-- Create policy for workers - service role can manage all workers
    29→CREATE POLICY "Service role can manage workers" ON public.workers
    30→    FOR ALL USING (auth.role() = 'service_role');
    31→
    32→-- Create policy for authenticated users to view workers (read-only)
    33→CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can view workers" ON public.workers
    34→    FOR SELECT USING (auth.role() = 'authenticated');

1→-- Optimize claim_next_task with single-query approach
     2→-- This migration creates optimized functions for both service role and user token paths
     3→
     4→-- =============================================================================
     5→-- 1. SERVICE ROLE PATH: Claim tasks from any user (cloud processing)
     6→-- =============================================================================
     7→
     8→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION claim_next_task_service_role(
     9→  p_worker_id TEXT,
    10→  p_include_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
    11→)
    12→RETURNS TABLE(
    13→  task_id UUID,
    14→  params JSONB,
    15→  task_type TEXT,
    16→  project_id UUID,
    17→  user_id UUID
    18→) 
    19→LANGUAGE plpgsql
    20→SECURITY DEFINER
    21→AS $$
    22→DECLARE
    23→  v_task_id UUID;
    24→  v_params JSONB;
    25→  v_task_type TEXT;
    26→  v_project_id UUID;
    27→  v_user_id UUID;
    28→  v_status_filter TEXT[];
    29→BEGIN
    30→  -- Set status filter based on include_active flag
    31→  IF p_include_active THEN
    32→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued', 'In Progress'];
    33→  ELSE
    34→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued'];
    35→  END IF;
    36→
    37→  -- Single atomic query to find and claim the next eligible task
    38→  WITH eligible_users AS (
    39→    -- Pre-filter users who meet all criteria
    40→    SELECT 
    41→      u.id as user_id,
    42→      u.credits,
    43→      COALESCE((u.settings->'ui'->'generationMethods'->>'inCloud')::boolean, true) as allows_cloud,
    44→      COUNT(in_progress_tasks.id) as in_progress_count
    45→    FROM users u
    46→    LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.user_id = u.id
    47→    LEFT JOIN tasks in_progress_tasks ON in_progress_tasks.project_id = p.id 
    48→      AND in_progress_tasks.status = 'In Progress'
    49→    WHERE u.credits > 0
    50→      AND COALESCE((u.settings->'ui'->'generationMethods'->>'inCloud')::boolean, true) = true
    51→    GROUP BY u.id, u.credits, u.settings
    52→    HAVING COUNT(in_progress_tasks.id) < 5
    53→  ),
    54→  ready_tasks AS (
    55→    -- Find tasks that meet dependency criteria
    56→    -- NOTE: include_active mode is for COUNTING only, not claiming
    57→    SELECT 
    58→      t.id,
    59→      t.params,
    60→      t.task_type,
    61→      t.project_id,
    62→      t.created_at,

    67→    LEFT JOIN tasks dep ON t.dependant_on = dep.id
    68→    WHERE t.status = 'Queued'

    72→      )
    73→  ),
    74→  active_tasks AS (

    76→    SELECT 
    77→      t.id,
    78→      t.params,
    79→      t.task_type,
    80→      t.project_id,
    81→      t.created_at,
    82→      p.user_id,
    83→      999 as rn  -- High number so they don't get claimed
    84→    FROM tasks t
    85→    JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.id
    86→    WHERE p_include_active AND t.status = 'In Progress'
    87→  ),
    88→  combined_tasks AS (
    89→    SELECT * FROM ready_tasks
    90→    UNION ALL
    91→    SELECT * FROM active_tasks
    92→  )
    93→  -- Atomically claim the first eligible task
    94→  UPDATE tasks 
    95→  SET 
    96→    status = CASE 
    97→      WHEN status = 'Queued' THEN 'In Progress'::task_status 
    98→      ELSE status 
    99→    END,

   102→      ELSE worker_id

   112→  FROM ready_tasks rt

   115→    AND (NOT p_include_active OR tasks.status = 'Queued') -- Only update if it's still claimable
   116→  RETURNING

   120→    tasks.project_id,
   121→    rt.user_id

   123→

   128→    task_type := v_task_type;

   130→    user_id := v_user_id;

   132→  END IF;

   134→  RETURN;
   135→END;

   154→AS $$

   165→  -- Set status filter based on include_active flag
   166→  IF p_include_active THEN

   168→  ELSE
   169→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued'];
   170→  END IF;
   171→
   172→  -- Get user preferences and validate eligibility
   173→  SELECT 
   174→    u.credits,
   175→    COALESCE((u.settings->'ui'->'generationMethods'->>'onComputer')::boolean, true),
   176→    COUNT(in_progress_tasks.id)
   177→  INTO v_user_credits, v_allows_local, v_in_progress_count
   178→  FROM users u
   179→  LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.user_id = u.id
   180→  LEFT JOIN tasks in_progress_tasks ON in_progress_tasks.project_id = p.id

   190→  -- Single atomic query to find and claim the next eligible task for this user
   191→  WITH user_projects AS (

   220→    END,

   222→      WHEN status = 'Queued' THEN NOW()

   229→  FROM ready_tasks rt

   253→-- =============================================================================
   254→-- 3. DRY RUN FUNCTIONS: Count eligible tasks without claiming
   255→-- =============================================================================
   256→
   257→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION count_eligible_tasks_service_role(
   258→  p_include_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
   259→)
   260→RETURNS INTEGER
   261→LANGUAGE plpgsql
   262→SECURITY DEFINER
   263→AS $$
   264→DECLARE
   265→  v_status_filter TEXT[];
   266→  v_count INTEGER;
   267→BEGIN
   268→  -- Set status filter based on include_active flag
   269→  IF p_include_active THEN
   270→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued', 'In Progress'];
   271→  ELSE
   272→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued'];
   273→  END IF;
   274→
   275→  -- Count eligible tasks using same logic as claim function
   276→  WITH eligible_users AS (
   277→    SELECT 
   278→      u.id as user_id
   279→    FROM users u
   280→    LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.user_id = u.id
   281→    LEFT JOIN tasks in_progress_tasks ON in_progress_tasks.project_id = p.id 
   282→      AND in_progress_tasks.status = 'In Progress'
   283→    WHERE u.credits > 0
   284→      AND COALESCE((u.settings->'ui'->'generationMethods'->>'inCloud')::boolean, true) = true
   285→    GROUP BY u.id, u.credits, u.settings
   286→    HAVING COUNT(in_progress_tasks.id) < 5
   287→  )
   288→  SELECT COUNT(*)
   289→  INTO v_count
   290→  FROM tasks t
   291→  JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.id
   292→  JOIN eligible_users eu ON eu.user_id = p.user_id
   293→  LEFT JOIN tasks dep ON t.dependant_on = dep.id
   294→  WHERE t.status = ANY(v_status_filter)
   295→    AND (
   296→      (p_include_active AND t.status = 'In Progress') OR
   297→      (t.status = 'Queued' AND (t.dependant_on IS NULL OR dep.status = 'Complete'))
   298→    );
   299→
   300→  RETURN v_count;
   301→END;
   302→$$;
   303→
   304→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION count_eligible_tasks_user(
   305→  p_user_id UUID,
   306→  p_include_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
   307→)
   308→RETURNS INTEGER
   309→LANGUAGE plpgsql

   311→AS $$
   312→DECLARE
   313→  v_status_filter TEXT[];
   314→  v_count INTEGER;
   315→  v_allows_local BOOLEAN;
   316→  v_user_credits NUMERIC;
   317→  v_in_progress_count INTEGER;
   318→BEGIN
   319→  -- Set status filter based on include_active flag
   320→  IF p_include_active THEN
   321→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued', 'In Progress'];
   322→  ELSE
   323→    v_status_filter := ARRAY['Queued'];
   324→  END IF;
   325→
   326→  -- Get user preferences and validate eligibility
   327→  SELECT 
   328→    u.credits,
   329→    COALESCE((u.settings->'ui'->'generationMethods'->>'onComputer')::boolean, true),
   330→    COUNT(in_progress_tasks.id)
   331→  INTO v_user_credits, v_allows_local, v_in_progress_count
   332→  FROM users u
   333→  LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.user_id = u.id
   334→  LEFT JOIN tasks in_progress_tasks ON in_progress_tasks.project_id = p.id 
   335→    AND in_progress_tasks.status = 'In Progress'
   336→  WHERE u.id = p_user_id
   337→  GROUP BY u.id, u.credits, u.settings;
   338→
   339→  -- Early exit if user doesn't meet basic criteria
   340→  IF NOT v_allows_local OR v_user_credits <= 0 OR v_in_progress_count >= 5 THEN
   341→    RETURN 0;
   342→  END IF;
   343→
   344→  -- Count eligible tasks for this user
   345→  WITH user_projects AS (
   346→    SELECT id FROM projects WHERE user_id = p_user_id

   348→  SELECT COUNT(*)
   349→  INTO v_count
   350→  FROM tasks t

   353→  WHERE t.status = ANY(v_status_filter)

   357→    );

1→-- Migration: Add task processing triggers to replace Express polling
     2→-- This replaces the 10-second polling with instant database-driven processing
     3→
     4→-- Enable the http extension for making API calls
     5→CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS http;
     6→
     7→-- Function to process completed tasks via Edge Function
     8→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION process_completed_task_trigger()
     9→RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
    10→DECLARE
    11→    supabase_url text;
    12→    service_role_key text;
    13→    edge_function_url text;
    14→    response_status int;
    15→BEGIN
    16→    -- Only process tasks that just became 'Complete' and need generation processing
    17→    IF NEW.status = 'Complete' 
    18→       AND OLD.status != 'Complete' 
    19→       AND NEW.generation_created = FALSE
    20→       AND NEW.generation_processed_at IS NOT NULL
    21→       AND NEW.task_type IN ('travel_stitch', 'single_image') THEN
    22→        
    23→        -- Get Supabase configuration from environment
    24→        supabase_url := current_setting('app.supabase_url', true);
    25→        service_role_key := current_setting('app.service_role_key', true);
    26→        
    27→        -- Skip if configuration is not available (prevents errors in development)
    28→        IF supabase_url IS NULL OR service_role_key IS NULL THEN
    29→            RAISE LOG 'Supabase configuration not available for task processing trigger';
    30→            RETURN NEW;
    31→        END IF;
    32→        
    33→        -- Construct Edge Function URL
    34→        edge_function_url := supabase_url || '/functions/v1/process-completed-task';
    35→        
    36→        -- Call the Edge Function asynchronously
    37→        -- Note: Using http extension for non-blocking call
    38→        BEGIN
    39→            SELECT status INTO response_status
    40→            FROM http_post(
    41→                edge_function_url,
    42→                jsonb_build_object('task_id', NEW.id),
    43→                'application/json',
    44→                ARRAY[
    45→                    http_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' || service_role_key),
    46→                    http_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    47→                ]
    48→            );
    49→            
    50→            -- Log the response for debugging
    51→            RAISE LOG 'Task processing trigger called for task % with status %', NEW.id, response_status;
    52→            
    53→        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    54→            -- Don't fail the original transaction if the Edge Function call fails
    55→            RAISE LOG 'Failed to call task processing Edge Function for task %: %', NEW.id, SQLERRM;
    56→        END;
    57→    END IF;
    58→    
    59→    RETURN NEW;
    60→END;
    61→$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
    62→
    63→-- Create the trigger on task status updates
    64→CREATE TRIGGER trigger_process_completed_tasks
    65→    AFTER UPDATE ON tasks
    66→    FOR EACH ROW
    67→    EXECUTE FUNCTION process_completed_task_trigger();
    68→
    69→-- Function to broadcast task status updates for real-time UI
    70→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION broadcast_task_status_update()
    71→RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
    72→DECLARE
    73→    supabase_url text;
    74→    service_role_key text;
    75→    broadcast_channel text;
    76→BEGIN
    77→    -- Only broadcast for status changes on non-completed tasks
    78→    IF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status)
    79→       OR (TG_OP = 'INSERT') THEN
    80→        
    81→        -- Skip completed tasks as they're handled by the processing trigger
    82→        IF NEW.status IN ('Complete', 'Failed', 'Cancelled') THEN
    83→            RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
    84→        END IF;
    85→        
    86→        -- Get Supabase configuration
    87→        supabase_url := current_setting('app.supabase_url', true);
    88→        service_role_key := current_setting('app.service_role_key', true);
    89→        
    90→        IF supabase_url IS NOT NULL AND service_role_key IS NOT NULL THEN
    91→            -- Create broadcast channel name
    92→            broadcast_channel := 'task-updates:' || NEW.project_id;
    93→            
    94→            -- Use Supabase Realtime broadcast for real-time updates
    95→            -- This matches the existing useWebSocket hook expectations
    96→            PERFORM supabase_realtime.broadcast(
    97→                broadcast_channel,
    98→                'task-update',
    99→                json_build_object(
   100→                    'type', 'TASKS_STATUS_UPDATE',
   101→                    'payload', json_build_object(
   102→                        'projectId', NEW.project_id,
   103→                        'taskId', NEW.id,
   104→                        'status', NEW.status,
   105→                        'updated_at', NEW.updated_at
   106→                    )
   107→                )
   108→            );
   109→        END IF;
   110→    END IF;
   111→    
   112→    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
   113→END;
   114→$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
   115→
   116→-- Create trigger for real-time status broadcasts
   117→CREATE TRIGGER trigger_broadcast_task_status
   118→    AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON tasks
   119→    FOR EACH ROW
   120→    EXECUTE FUNCTION broadcast_task_status_update();
   121→
   122→-- Set up configuration settings (these should be set via environment variables)
   123→-- Note: These will need to be configured in your Supabase project settings
   124→COMMENT ON FUNCTION process_completed_task_trigger() IS 
   125→'Requires app.supabase_url and app.service_role_key to be set via ALTER DATABASE SET commands';
   126→
   127→COMMENT ON FUNCTION broadcast_task_status_update() IS 
   128→'Automatically broadcasts task status changes for real-time UI updates';
